ModMetaData.name: AtlasPreloadFix
ModMetaData.author: SleepSheepQwQ
ModMetaData.description:
Pre-bake residency selection for the Waylith static texture atlas.
Before StaticTextureAtlas packs a page, every member of that page is asked for a GPU-resident texture once. Textures that fail are removed from the page's input list, so they never get a StaticTextureAtlasTile and Graphic.TryGetTextureAtlasReplacementInfo keeps using the source texture instead of replacing it with an empty atlas tile. The source texture is also left out of the atlas eviction set, so it can still be loaded on demand.
A startup budget (ATLASFIX_BUDGET_MS, default 250 ms) abandons the pre-pass and leaves the page untouched if probing is too expensive. If every probe on a page fails (for example a host with no GPU service), the page is likewise left untouched instead of being emptied.
This is not a per-tile repair: the selection happens once, on the complete page input, before BuildMeshesForUvs runs.
